name: dumbbell seated bent over rear delt row
description: A seated bent-over row with elbows flared wide to hit the rear delts. Sitting keeps your legs from helping.
instructions: Sit at the end of a bench with a dumbbell in each hand.
Lean forward with a flat back, arms hanging.
Pull the weights toward your sides with elbows flared out.
Squeeze your rear delts and upper back.
Keep your chest close to your thighs.
